description_en: Unbinds a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) from a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 云连接网解绑云企业网
kebab_example: aliyun smartag detach-ccn-instance-from-cen --ccn-id ccn-isdjvvkexkrpk00000 --cen-id cen-9j8gkkj7z9vie9a8z9 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachCcnInstanceFromCen

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) that is attached to the CEN instance
parameters.name: ccn_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance from which you want to revoke the authorization
parameters.help_zh: 指定要撤销授权的云企业网实例的ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the regions supported by Smart Access Gateway and the corresponding region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions接口查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
